lazytrae.note: LazyTrae hooks configuration. Six Trae events: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop, Notification. PostCompact is a known gap handled via SessionStart detection + UserPromptSubmit context-pressure markers. See docs/lazytrae-hooks-reference.md for details.
lazytrae.safety: All hooks exit 0 always. They never block Trae operations. No network calls — pure local file I/O.
lazytrae.postcompact_gap: Trae has no PostCompact event. LazyTrae uses SessionStart to detect post_compact_recovery_needed flag and UserPromptSubmit to detect context-pressure markers. See docs/lazytrae-hooks-reference.md §PostCompact Gap Mitigation.
